2 -(OET Reading
)-

watch this video list to have a general overview about the reading subtest.
https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLPjVMFCQ53SGDF3DDJ5H3nKasJqCMkaTH

=====
If you are already aware of the exam and you just want to improve your reading skill:

You have to read at least one medical article daily and record any new word you face.
This pracice will enhance your reading speed and focus better if you face complicated articles.

these sites are recommended by OET official site:

https://www.sciencedaily.com/

https://breakingnewsenglish.com/

https://theconversation.com/uk/health

https://www.nejm.org/

https://www.medscape.com/

https://medicinetoday.com.au/
